items.title: Skilful Reminding: Recalling a Forgotten Fault

items.zh: 云何名為善作憶念？謂令憶念先所犯罪，或法、或義。云何名為令其憶念先所犯罪？謂若有餘，先起毀犯而不能憶，善作方便，令彼憶念。告言：長老！曾於某處、某事、某時，毀犯如是如是色類。
items.en: What is meant by skilful reminding? It means causing someone to recall a fault previously committed, or a teaching, or its meaning. What is meant by causing someone to recall a fault previously committed? It means that, when another has committed a violation but cannot recall it, one skilfully finds a means to help them remember, saying: Venerable one, at such a place, on such an occasion, at such a time, you committed a violation regarding such and such [matters of a renunciant's] form.

items.zh: 如是名為令其憶念先所犯罪。

items.title: Skilful Reminding Completes: Forgotten Teachings and Forgotten Good Deeds

items.zh: 云何名為令憶念法？謂若有餘，於先所聞、所受正法，獨處思念。所謂契經、應頌、記別，廣說如前。彼若不憶，令其憶念，或復稱述、授與令憶，或興請問、詰難令憶。如是名為令憶念法。云何名為令憶念義？謂若有餘，於先所聞、所受正義，有所忘失，為作憶念，宣說開示，令新令顯。又若有善能引義利、能引梵行，久時所作、久時所說，彼若忘失，亦令憶念。如是名為善作憶念。
items.en: What is meant by causing someone to recall a teaching? It means that, when another, reflecting alone on a teaching previously heard and received, cannot recall it, one skilfully helps them remember — repeating it back, supplying it directly, or drawing it out through questions and probing inquiry. What is meant by causing someone to recall its meaning? It means that, when another has forgotten the meaning of a teaching previously heard and received, one helps them recall it, explaining and clarifying it so that it appears fresh and clear once more. And if there is some wholesome deed or word, capable of bringing real benefit and supporting pure conduct, done or spoken long ago, which they have forgotten, one likewise helps them recall it. This is called skilful reminding.

items.title: Section: Skilful Instruction — Thirteen Kinds of Discourse for Calming and Insight

items.zh: 云何名為善能教授？謂於遠離、寂靜瑜伽作意止觀，時時隨順教授而轉，時時宣說與彼相應無倒言論。所謂能趣心離障蓋甚可愛樂尸羅言論、等持言論、聖慧言論、解脫言論、解脫智見言論。少欲言論、喜足言論。永斷言論、離欲言論、寂滅言論。損減言論、無雜言論、隨順緣性緣起言論。如是名為善能教授。
items.en: What is meant by skilful instruction? It means constantly guiding a student, in keeping with seclusion, stillness, and meditative attention to calming and insight, and constantly setting forth discourse that accords with these, free of error — discourse capable of leading the mind towards freedom from the obstructions and hindrances, and deeply delightful in itself: discourse on discipline, on concentration, on noble wisdom, on liberation, on the knowledge and vision of liberation, on having few desires, on contentment, on permanent abandonment, on freedom from craving, on cessation, on diminishment, on freedom from admixture, and on conformity with conditionality and dependent origination.

items.title: Section: Skilful Guidance — Correcting, Reintegrating, and Directing a Community

items.zh: 云何名為善能教誡？謂於大師所說聖教，能以正法、以毘奈耶平等教誨。或軌範師，或親教師，或同法者，或餘尊重、等尊重者，如實知彼隨於一處違越毀犯，便於時時如法呵責、治罰、驅擯，令其調伏。既調伏已，如法平等受諸利養，和同、曉悟、收斂、攝受。於所應作及不應作，為令現行不現行故。於其積習及不積習，教導教誨。如是名為善能教誡。
items.en: What is meant by skilful guidance? It means teaching with even-handed instruction, according to the true teaching and the discipline the great Teacher himself set forth. … Knowing truthfully that someone has, in some respect, transgressed or violated the training, one rightly censures, disciplines, or, if necessary, expels them, so as to bring about their correction. Once corrected, one allows them to share equally in the community's support once more, working in harmony with them, helping them understand clearly, restraining what should be restrained, and welcoming them back. Regarding what should be done and what should not, one ensures the one occurs and the other does not; regarding habits already formed and habits not yet formed, one instructs and guides accordingly. This is called skilful guidance.

items.title: Section: Skilful Teaching of the True Dharma — From Worldly Good to the Four Noble Truths

items.zh: 云何名為善說正法？謂於時時能善宣說初時所作無倒言論。所謂施論、戒論、生天之論。於諸欲中，能廣開示過患出離清淨品法。又於時時宣說超勝四種聖諦相應言論。所謂苦論、集論、滅論、道論。
items.en: What is meant by skilful teaching of the true Dharma? It means being able, from time to time, to teach correctly what a newcomer should first take up — namely, discourse on giving, discourse on discipline, and discourse on rebirth in the heavens — and, regarding sensual desires, broadly revealing their dangers, and the pure qualities found in renouncing them. And it further means, from time to time, teaching discourse connected with the four noble truths, which surpasses all else — namely, discourse on suffering, on its origin, on its cessation, and on the path.

items.zh: 為諸有情得成熟故，為諸有情得清淨故，為令正法得久住故，宣說相應、助伴、隨順、清亮、有用、相稱、應順名句文身所有言論。

items.title: Section: Skilful Teaching Completes, and All Eight Marks Define a "Good Friend"

items.zh: 又此言論應時而發、殷重、漸次、相續、俱有。令其欣慶、令其愛樂、令其歡喜、令其勇悍、無所訶擯、相應、助伴、無亂、如法、稱順眾會。有慈憐心，有利益心，有哀愍心，不依利養、恭敬、讚頌，不自高舉、不陵蔑他。如是名為善說正法。由彼成就如是八支，於時時間善能諫舉、善作憶念、善能教授、善能教誡、善說正法，是故說彼名為善友。
items.en: Furthermore, this discourse is offered at the proper time, with earnest seriousness, in proper sequence, without interruption, complete in both structure and content, bringing about delight, fondness, joy, and courageous resolve in the listener, free of anything open to reproach, in accordance with reason, mutually supportive, free of confusion, in keeping with the true teaching, and suited to the assembly at hand. It is offered with a heart of loving-kindness, a heart seeking the listener's benefit, and a heart of compassion, never for the sake of gain, honour, or praise, never with arrogance, and never belittling another. This is called skilful teaching of the true Dharma. Having accomplished these eight factors, one is, from time to time, skilled at admonishing, skilled at reminding, skilled at instructing, skilled at guiding, and skilled at teaching the true Dharma — and it is for this reason that such a one is called a good friend.

items.title: The Brief Summary of Good Companionship Opens

items.zh: 如是廣辯善友性已。復云何知此中略義？
items.en: Thus has good companionship been explained in detail. How, then, should the brief summary of this teaching be understood?

items.title: Section: Good Companionship Closes — Four Factors, and the Whole Teaching Complete

items.zh: 謂若善友心善稠密，為性哀愍，最初於彼樂為利益、樂為安樂。又即於此利益安樂，如實了知，無有顛倒，離顛倒見。又即於此利益安樂，有大勢力、方便善巧，能令積集、能令引發。又即於此利益安樂，翹勤無墮，起發圓滿，為性好樂，發勤精進。當知由此四因緣故，攝一切種總、略圓滿善知識性。如是名為此善友性所有略義。若前所說廣分別義，若此所說所有略義，一切總說為善友性。
items.en: A good friend's mind is thoroughly settled and compassionate by nature, from the very outset delighting in bringing others benefit and ease. Regarding that very benefit and ease, one understands it truly, free of distortion, free of any mistaken view. Regarding that very benefit and ease, one has great capability and skilful means, able to help others accumulate it and bring it forth. And regarding that very benefit and ease, one is diligent and never lazy, arousing complete energy, delighting in it by nature, generating sustained effort. Know that by these four causal factors, the nature of a good friend is entirely and completely encompassed, in full and in brief alike. This is the brief summary of good companionship. Both what was explained in detail before, and this brief summary given now, are together called good companionship.

blocks.text: How the good friend actually helps: four of the five functions, and a summary in four factors.
"Causing someone to recall a fault previously committed, or a teaching, or its meaning": tactfully, without humiliation. When a friend cannot remember a teaching, one repeats it back or explains it.

"Constantly guiding a student in keeping with seclusion, stillness, and meditative attention to calming and insight", with discourse on discipline, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and the knowledge and vision of liberation. Venerable Miào Jìng: discourse on "permanent abandonment" really means the four foundations of mindfulness.

Teaching according to the Vinaya: knowing that someone has transgressed, "one rightly censures, disciplines, or, if necessary, expels them, to bring about their correction". Venerable Miào Jìng: a slight fault gets a light response. Master Cháng Bǎi: leading others to calm is guidance; to insight, instruction.

First "discourse on giving, discipline, and rebirth in the heavens"; then, when the listener is ready, the four noble truths. Venerable Miào Jìng: giving, discipline, meditation: what one learns first. The teaching is given "at the proper time, in proper sequence, complete".
Four factors encompass the good friend: a settled, compassionate mind; true understanding of benefit; skill in teaching; and tireless effort.
This passage describes what Jennafer and Luke are doing together in this course. The friend's role is not only to teach, but to remind, encourage, and sometimes correct, with kindness.

quiz.q: In "you violated such and such 色類," the English has "a fault of such and such a kind." How do the lectures read 色類?
options: the monastic appearance the offender should uphold (shaved head and so on), which they violated
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: for instance, you are a monastic, having given up lay adornment and shaved your head — that is your form. Master Cháng Bǎi: the offender violated the humble form proper to one who has gone forth. The English reads it as a category of fault.

quiz.q: How does Venerable Miào Jìng distinguish reminding someone of a "teaching" from reminding them of its "meaning"?
options: the teaching is the words that express; the meaning is the principle expressed
quiz.why: "When another has forgotten the meaning of a teaching previously heard and received, one helps them recall it, explaining and clarifying it so that it appears fresh and clear once more." Venerable Miào Jìng: the "teaching" is the expressing words; the "meaning" is the principle expressed.

quiz.q: Which discourses does skilful instruction set forth, and which five does Venerable Miào Jìng call the fivefold Dharma body?
options: the thirteen discourses beginning with discipline, concentration, wisdom, liberation, and knowledge and vision of liberation — the first five being the fivefold Dharma body
quiz.why: "Discourse on discipline, on concentration, on noble wisdom, on liberation, on the knowledge and vision of liberation …" Venerable Miào Jìng: once freed from afflictions, you know you are liberated — that is the discourse on the knowledge and vision of liberation; these are the fivefold Dharma body.

quiz.q: What does Venerable Miào Jìng say "discourse on permanent abandonment" really means practising?
options: the four foundations of mindfulness, chiefly the contemplation of non-self
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: discourse on permanent abandonment here really means practising the four foundations of mindfulness, chiefly the contemplation of non-self.

quiz.q: In skilful guidance, how does one deal with an offender, and how does Venerable Miào Jìng grade the three measures?
options: censure, discipline, or expel to correct them; light faults censured, heavier disciplined, gravest expelled
quiz.why: "One rightly censures, disciplines, or, if necessary, expels them, so as to bring about their correction." Venerable Miào Jìng: a slight fault gets a rebuke; a heavier one, discipline; the most serious, expulsion.

quiz.q: In teaching the true Dharma, what does one first teach newcomers, and what afterwards?
options: first giving, discipline, and heavenly rebirth; then the four noble truths
quiz.why: "Namely, discourse on giving, discourse on discipline, and discourse on rebirth in the heavens … and further, from time to time, teaching discourse connected with the four noble truths." Master Cháng Bǎi: "what is first to be done" is the error-free teaching that beings newly arrived in the Dharma should know.

quiz.q: By how many causal factors is good companionship summarised, and how does Venerable Miào Jìng explain "thoroughly settled"?
options: four; 稠 means 密, and 密 means stillness
quiz.why: "Know that by these four causal factors, the nature of a good friend is entirely and completely encompassed." Venerable Miào Jìng: 稠 is 密, and what does 密 mean? Stillness.
